settings.heading: 5 Reasons MacuDrops Is Different From Every Eye Supplement You’ve Tried
It Has All Three Macular Pigments
settings.text: Your macula is built from lutein, zeaxanthin and meso-zeaxanthin. Many eye supplements include only the first two. MacuDrops includes all three, at 20mg, 2mg and 2mg.

settings.heading: It Skips the Capsule
settings.text: Carotenoids are fat-soluble and absorb poorly from a dry capsule. MacuDrops are micellized in MCT oil and taken under the tongue, so there’s no capsule to break down first.

settings.heading: It Goes Beyond Pigments
settings.text: Astaxanthin, saffron, zinc and ginkgo support the retina’s antioxidant defenses, its metabolism and its circulation.*

settings.heading: 60 Seconds, Once a Day
settings.text: No handful of pills, no timing around meals. One dropper under the tongue while you make your coffee.

settings.heading: Made in Japan, Tested Every Batch
settings.text: Small-batch production in a GMP-certified facility, with third-party testing on every batch. And a 60-day money-back guarantee.

settings.q: How long until I notice anything?
settings.a: Macular pigment builds gradually. Research on lutein and zeaxanthin usually measures changes over 3 to 6 months of daily use, so we recommend giving MacuDrops at least 3 months.*

settings.q: Does MacuDrops replace my eye injections or laser treatment?
settings.a: No. MacuDrops is a dietary supplement, not a treatment for any eye disease. If you have diabetic retinopathy, macular degeneration or any other eye condition, keep every appointment and follow your eye doctor’s treatment plan.

settings.q: Is it safe with my medications?
settings.a: Show the ingredient list to your doctor before starting, especially if you take blood thinners (warfarin, aspirin, clopidogrel), because ginkgo biloba can affect bleeding. Ask your doctor if you are pregnant or nursing.
